label: LlamaIndex
description: The workflow becomes a LlamaIndex flow: an async function for each block, LlamaIndex FunctionAgents (OpenAILike LLM, tools, output_cls for typed answers) for the AI blocks, and a FLOW that AgentCanvas's flow engine runs as the canvas draws it. Any catalog model works, and tool calls can wait for a person's approval (the agent workflow's InputRequiredEvent and HumanResponseEvent). Runs need LlamaIndex installed on the server (`make framework FW=llamaindex`); designing and exporting do not. No saved history, state editing or breakpoints; a paused run lives in memory.

notes.core.wait: a Wait step needs saved checkpoints that a scheduler can wake days later: run this workflow on LangGraph (Framework in the workflow settings)
notes.core.set: an async function that returns the fields it sets
notes.core.router: the flow engine follows the first route whose CEL rule matches (generated orchestration: the flow is not one LlamaIndex Workflow with an event per edge yet)
notes.core.join: the flow engine waits for every branch before the block runs
notes.core.approval: the run pauses and is saved as JSON; it continues from that step when a person answers
notes.core.human_input: the run pauses and asks again when an answer does not fit
notes.core.script: your workspace function is called from the flow
notes.knowledge.search: the flow searches the knowledge base; exports search its file with the built-in embedder
notes.core.llm: a LlamaIndex FunctionAgent with the block's model, run once
notes.core.agent: a LlamaIndex FunctionAgent (system prompt, OpenAILike LLM, tools, output_cls); tools named in 'Ask before using' wait inside the agent's workflow (InputRequiredEvent, then HumanResponseEvent): its serialized Context and chat memory are saved with the pause and it continues when a person approves, edits or rejects the call (one call at a time)
notes.mw.model_call_limit: the agent's own max_iterations: past the limit the agent stops with a note, or the run fails when the block says so
notes.core.decide: the step asks its model once (an "Ask AI" call) to pick a path and say how sure it is, saves {choice, confidence, reason}, and the flow engine follows the choice (the default path when there is none or it is below the minimum confidence)
